name: SCANO (DCTS)
description: SCANO, the paper model: Transolver-type slice operator with BQA and AGS, one whole-room forward pass (about 1 s on an RTX 4090).
description_zh: 论文主模型 SCANO：切片算子 + 边界求积注意力（BQA）+ 锚定全局状态（AGS），整室一次前向（RTX 4090 约 1 秒）。
dataset: DCTS (500 parametric GTC rooms; 400 train / 50 val / 50 test)
metric: mean over the five fields of the per-field relative L2 error

memory.note: peak = node_bytes x nodes + query rows x (query_row_bytes + query_row_bytes_per_mface x boundary faces / 1e6) + anchor rows x anchor_row_bytes (every query row attends to the boundary records); rows = rows_per_pivot x pivots; fit on an RTX 4090, docs/benchmarks/scano-tta-2026-10-29
